entities.name: Luneau
entities.description: A now ruined island kingdom and its capital city on Ixalan, under the influence of the Legion of Dusk and famed for its decadent culture and vampiric nobility.

entities.name: Legion of Dusk
entities.description: The vampire faction that rules Luneau, sustaining itself through ritual blood tribute and strict social stratification.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: The plane from whose jungles Luneau's Royal Menagerie gathers its creatures.

entities.name: Hall of Treasures
entities.description: A museum in Luneau curated by taxidermists that immortalized the island's exotic conquests.

entities.name: Perfumed Court
entities.description: The seat of the vampire royals and royal palace of Luneau.

entities.name: Royal Menagerie
entities.description: An extensive collection of rare beasts in Luneau, many imported alive from the jungles of Ixalan.

entities.name: Rite of Redemption
entities.description: The system by which Luneau's mortals paid their debts in blood to feed their immortal overseers.

entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: A planeswalker from Skalla who travels to Luneau, is captured and tortured by the Baron of Vernot, and then frees the Royal Menagerie's beasts.

entities.name: Frederic
entities.description: A vampire huntsman who accompanies Vivien to Luneau and defends its system as civilization and preservation.

entities.name: Baron of Vernot
entities.description: A sadistic aristocrat-scientist who steals Vivien's Arkbow and tortures her to learn to control it; he is killed by a monstrosaur.

entities.name: Arkbow
entities.description: Vivien's artifact that channels the spirits of extinct beasts from Skalla and preserves and restores animals.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The elder dragon planeswalker who defeated Vivien and whom she seeks power to defeat.

entities.name: Shiv
entities.description: The plane of dragons that Vivien turns her focus to after Luneau.

entities.name: Monstrosaur
entities.description: Large dinosaurs kept captive and tortured for entertainment in Luneau; one is freed by Vivien and kills the Baron.

events.summary: Vivien arrives in Luneau aboard a ship carrying a captured juvenile brontodon, accompanied by the vampire huntsman Frederic.
events.quote: Vivien Reid travelled to Luneau aboard a ship transporting a captured juvenile brontodon

events.summary: Vivien learns that Luneau uses blood as currency and treats humans as livestock for its Legion of Dusk rulers.
events.quote: Vivien learned that the city relied on blood as currency

events.summary: At a gala, Vivien sees captive beasts tortured for the nobles' entertainment and summons a hydra, wurm and stag with her Arkbow to disrupt it, freeing a mutilated monstrosaur and escaping.
events.quote: Vivien used her Arkbow to summon a hydra

events.summary: Vivien is captured and tortured by the Baron of Vernot, who has stolen her Arkbow; she refuses to reveal its secrets.
events.quote: The Baron had stolen Vivien's Arkbow

events.summary: The Baron moves Vivien to a gilded prison where she remains in magical stasis, reliving the loss of Skalla and her defeat by Nicol Bolas.
events.quote: Later, the Baron moved her to a gilded prison

events.summary: The Baron summons Vivien to witness a monstrosaur's vivisection and demands she teach him to use the Arkbow; she feigns cooperation and asserts that the power is hers.
events.quote: The Baron summoned Vivien to witness the vivisection of a monstrosaur

events.summary: Forced to perform the ritual, Vivien lets the Arkbow reject the Baron's guard, enlarges a spider to disrupt her prison and unleashes a dying monstrosaur's essence, which kills the Baron.
events.quote: The Baron was killed by the monstrosaur

events.summary: Vivien releases the Royal Menagerie's beasts, which overrun the city and kill or scatter the vampire rulers while humans rejoice.
events.quote: The vampire rulers were killed or scattered as the wild reclaimed Luneau City.

events.summary: Vivien planeswalks away to seek the dragons of Shiv, leaving Luneau to the beasts and humans.
events.quote: She planeswalked away, leaving Luneau to the beasts and humans.

relations.note: Under the Legion's rule; an island kingdom under the Legion's influence.
relations.quote: an island kingdom under the influence of the Legion of Dusk

relations.note: Accompanies her to Luneau, though she grows repelled by his rationalizations.

relations.quote: He subjected Vivien to physical and magical torture to learn how to control the Arkbow

relations.note: Defeated by him and seeks power to defeat him.
relations.quote: seeking the power needed to defeat Nicol Bolas
